simple.summary: בֶּטַח (Beṭach) means Betach , a place in Syria First listed occurrence: 2Sam 8 8.

definitions.full: H984. Betach II. בֶּ֫טַח proper name, of a location city of Hadadezer king of Zobah 2Sam 8:8 (but read rather טִבְחַת so 1Chr 18:8 ; ᵐ5 Sm Μασβακ , ᵐ5 L Ματεβακ ; ᵐ5 Chronicles Μεταβηχας , ᵐ5 L ταβααθ ; compare also We Dr). II. בטח (√ assumed for following).
